description: Waterways named by drawbridge titles and 33 CFR 117 headings: one row per entity, raw form, source and document.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.description: Canonical id of the entity: SHA-256 of its key.

columns.name: key
columns.description: Normalisation key shared by every raw form of the entity.

columns.name: raw
columns.description: The raw form as a source row gives it.

columns.name: source_table
columns.description: Table the raw form was read from, or ecfr_headings.

columns.name: source_column
columns.description: Column the raw form was read from.

columns.name: doc_id
columns.description: Document the raw form comes from (the row's access is its).

columns.name: rows
columns.description: Source rows of the document that hold this raw form.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Per-view name: the byte-smallest raw form among the visible rows.
